question: Does the complete same-direction two-served-station integer line give a physically valid strict decrease of the original F from the three preselected Round88 A2 witnesses, and at what complete diagnostic cost?

mechanism.station_pairs: all currently served distinct station pairs a<b in ascending station index
mechanism.line: Y_a(t)=Y_a+t, Y_b(t)=Y_b+t; all other inventories fixed
mechanism.integer_t: every capacity-feasible integer t including signs; t=0 is the verified baseline, not an accepted move
mechanism.candidate_routes: preserve vehicle assignment and visit order; recompute signed net operation; delete nodes whose operation becomes zero; no inserted or moved stations
mechanism.validation: original C++ Evaluator/verifySolution and computeObjectiveParts on every candidate, including all load prefixes, return-load handling, actual route travel and T+1e-7 behavior
mechanism.acceptance: only physical and identity-valid candidates with original F lower than current verified F by the unchanged 1e-12 strict-improvement gate; choose lowest F with deterministic (a,b,t) tie-break
mechanism.iteration: complete best scan; accept one strict best improvement; rescan the entire current co-direction neighborhood until no strict improvement
mechanism.scope: isolated offline mechanism diagnostic, not integrated R76/R83 closure and not a complete ENS-C run
forbidden: historical optimal value or UB injection

execution.timeout: unknown with committed partial evidence and paid cost; no resume or extension
execution.stopping: identity/correctness/resource failure stops batch and preserves paid prefix; a complete negative case does not add cases or seeds
execution.driver_bind_rule: Root must bind final source and binary hashes in a separate qualification gate before any case launch; this manifest does not invent them
execution.run_requires: independent static review, G1 fixture and original-Evaluator qualification, input/witness hash recheck, exclusive compute slot, explicit root run lease

cases.source: Round88 A1 startup-only ENS-C final result; fixed A2 D6 witness
cases.historical_evidence: runner_a1_startup_d6/raw/01_D6_ENS-C/audit.json neutral_closure.passed=true and result.exhausted=true, optimizer_calls=0; result.json verification original feasible/recomputed; fresh diagnostic still revalidates

cases.source: Round88 G3 ENS-C first same-run verified startup witness; fixed A2 E8 witness
cases.historical_evidence: runner_a1_g3/raw/02_E8_ENS-C/audit.json first witness source=same_run_verified_startup; neutral_exchange passed/exhausted, two equal-F relocations, zero strict moves; selected initial route is not claimed identical to later closure final route
cases.witness_stage: first verified startup witness, before equal-F neutral route changes

cases.source: Round88 G3 ENS-C first same-run verified startup witness; fixed A2 S12 witness
cases.historical_evidence: runner_a1_g3/raw/05_S12_ENS-C/audit.json first witness source=same_run_verified_startup; neutral_exchange passed/exhausted with zero neutral or strict moves; fresh diagnostic still revalidates
cases.witness_stage: first verified startup witness, old neutral closure made no move

required_case_evidence: pre/post source, diagnostic binary, input and witness hashes
original Evaluator baseline route, inventory, physical flags and F/G/P
every scanned (a,b,t), candidate route, original Evaluator valid/reject reason and F/G/P where valid
per-pass candidate count, physically valid count, best strict candidate and deterministic tie resolution
accepted moves and their time/order, complete rescans, exhaustion or timeout distinction
final verified route, inventory, F/G/P and delta from same-run baseline
outer launch-to-exit wall and child/process-tree status; nested costs identified but not added twice
all failures and partial events retained without retry
interpretation: A positive fixed-witness original-F decrease is mechanism evidence only. A complete no-improvement result covers only the scanned co-direction neighborhood of that fixed witness. Timeout is unknown. No result implies full-algorithm certification time or current-candidate held-out confirmation.
